Players Committee, [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Decipher Errata]], p. 15; cover identifies official text as of 1 June 2017. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, p. 117 (edition dated 30 July 2023). This is the consulted edition, not a first-publication date. The shared comparison includes the complete game text and distinguishes the later face stamp from the date of the underlying text. Original publication month is left unspecified. No card or GEMP identifiers were allocated. Glossary pp. 73–74 use ability in the loss comparison; later PC text uses defense value. The intermediate article uses documentary publication_id only and no card image; the current D-E1 face belongs to the later state.
